edges.subject: UniProtKB:P46380
edges.description: The experimentally purified A. methanolica enzyme is a homododecamer; one participant represents its repeated subunit identity.

edges.description: Dual-role AroQ catalyzes dehydroquinate dehydration in quinate catabolism; its separate biosynthetic role does not expand this pathway.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-17378 assigns CPLX-7980 to 3-DEHYDROQUINATE-DEHYDRATASE-RXN with EV-EXP-IDA-PURIFIED-PROTEIN-NH and PMID1479361.

edges.subject: UniProtKB:Q9X5C9

evidence.source_assertion: CPLX-7981 contains two MONOMER-15330 subunits; MONOMER-15330 maps to UniProtKB:Q9X5C9, whose issuing entry is ATCC 13032.

edges.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-7981
edges.description: The supported activity is the NAD+-using subset RXN-20483 of the broader native NAD(P) reaction. This is not an exact reaction mapping or proof of equivalent use of both coenzymes.

evidence.source_assertion: The native activity links CPLX-7981 to NAD-specific RXN-20483, supported by heterologously expressed purified protein (PMID18566515) and mutant phenotype (PMID19376919); these sources involve distinct strain scopes.
RXN-20483 consumes quinate and NAD, producing dehydroquinate, NADH and a proton; native direction is PHYSIOL-LEFT-TO-RIGHT.

endpoint_qualifiers.description: Recombinant ATCC 13032 QsuD homodimer preparation. Native evidence specifies heterologously expressed purified protein; the associated 2NLO structural sample carries a 19-residue N-terminal extension with His6. Cleavage state across all kinetic preparations was not independently verified.

evidence.source_assertion: The native activity links CPLX-7981 to NAD-specific RXN-20483, supported by heterologously expressed purified protein (PMID18566515) and mutant phenotype (PMID19376919); these sources involve distinct strain scopes.
2NLO entity1 is an N-tagged wild-type Cgl0424 sample from ATCC13032, expressed in BL21(DE3) from pETNHis. Its 302-residue sequence is exactly a 19-residue His6-containing prefix followed by Q9X5C9.
